dialect: Bash with default options, GNU/Linux utilities and LC_ALL=C. Each case runs in a fresh temporary working directory. Permission cases assume no default ACL.

37.script:
touch sample
chmod u=rw,g=r,o= sample
stat -c '%a' sample

66.script:
s=
if [ -z "$s" ]; then
  printf 'empty\n'
else
  printf 'set\n'
fi

68.script:
total=0
for n in 1 2 3; do
  total=$((total + n))
done
printf '%s\n' "$total"

69.script:
n=0
while [ "$n" -lt 3 ]; do
  n=$((n + 1))
done
printf '%s\n' "$n"
